name: harness-setup
title: Harness Setup
description: [root|clean|policy] Alone: set up or status. Text: add a source, or ask. Set up and steer a harness project: create it or convert an old layout, show status, select or move its root, register sources and coding repositories, brief a task, delete old run history, and set limits, failure handling, retention, and pause, stop, and resume. Shorthand: /hn-setup. Briefings overlap with handoff; harness-schedule schedules maintenance.
author: wzlwit

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: Menu word: root, clean, or policy. Alone, the skill sets up the harness or shows its status; other text adds a source, briefs a task, or answers from the briefing. Operation-specific approvals still apply.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Existing parent/controller path for root. Omission only displays locations. Select a valid new path, then prompt to move an initialized previous harness; Move is the default, including no answer. Explicit answers or user instructions override it. A skipped or failed move keeps the new root selected. Invalid paths do not change Root.

inputs.name: current-file
inputs.description: Canonical current-<project>.csv filename. Creating a harness accepts it for a new controller; with root it shows an explicit rename through Board and asks once. Existing files change only after a yes.
